notes.title: Update Live -
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

A new update has just gone live with the following fixes:
- Fixed a bug preventing the users to see the list of online rooms.
- Fixed a bug  where you could kill your own obelisk on online multiplayer sessions.
- Fixed various UI and text issues on multiplayer.
- Fixed some localization problems.
- Fixed errors while creating rooms for online multiplayer sessions.

notes.title: Space Overlords Launches
notes.content:
Space Overlords is out now!

Begin your journey to the centre of the universe and avenge your brothers. Level planets and decimate planetary defences that stand in your path. Cleanse Kesedihan’s evil from creation.

Take on the Story mode solo or team up with friends to storm the galaxies.
Battle it out with up to 4 players in online and local multiplayer modes, including Defend the Obelisk and Dark Infection game types.

Create your own playgrounds of destruction in the Level Editor, design planets and share them online for other players to try out.
